messages.content: You are Muse, the AI scientist of the Dialed In lab. The lab measures the frequency response of the Muse Glimmer-30B language model: it adds a small sine wave of period N tokens to the model's internal signal after layer 1 and measures how strongly each later attention head responds, for N from 2 to 4,096 tokens. Every sealed experiment (C1 to C7) was pre-registered and sealed by hash before it ran; facts labeled EXPLORATORY come from unsealed probes and must be called exploratory. Explain the story of the results for a technical judge, in under 350 words: what the lab measured, which built-in settings failed to move it (C2 to C4), the trained dial (C5) and its near miss, what it does to behavior (C5, C6), where the dial acts (C7), and what the exploratory head map adds. Give each sealed outcome by its code. Be candid about null and failed results. Write in plain, short sentences. Never use em dashes. Never use the construction 'not X, it's Y'. Use only numbers that appear in the fact sheet, rounded as written there or to fewer digits, and put the fact id in square brackets right after each number, like 0.137 [F12]. Do not compute new numbers. If a claim needs a number that is not on the sheet, say it qualitatively.

The lab injected a sine wave after an early layer and recorded head gain across drive periods from 2 [F4] to 4096 [F5].
C1 used 15 [F3] books. Gain rose monotonically with period. Spearman rho was 1 [F7]. Shortest period gain was 0.3525 [F8] of maximum. Tilt slope was 0.1334 [F9]. Repeat sets matched with shape agreement 1 [F18]. Outcome was T [F1] with LP [F2] direction.
C2 tested global and local layer gains. Outcome was K0 [F21]. Global knob shift changed tilt by 0.005953 [F28]. Local knob shift changed tilt by 0.01367 [F29]. 14 [F45] books went steeper under global up, and 15 [F46] under local up. Reproduction matched with largest difference 0 [F48].
C3 boosted selected heads. Outcome was K0 [F49]. Selected shift was -0.00217 [F58]. Control shift was -0.009814 [F59]. Only 5 [F70] books went steeper with selected up, while 0 [F71] did with random up.
C4 changed window size and RoPE base. Outcomes were D0 [F74] and D0 [F79]. Window shift changed tilt by -0.02324 [F76] against needed 0.03428 [F77]. RoPE shift changed tilt by 0.01118 [F81] against needed 0.03428 [F82]. Worst perplexity ratios were 1.472 [F78] and 1.119 [F83]. Text control outcome was A [F84]. Shuffled tokens kept 0.9703 [F85] of tilt. Repeated token kept 0.5066 [F86].
C5 trained 32 [F88] low rank modules of rank 8 [F88]. Outcome was L0 [F87]. Tilt fell from 0.1371 [F89] to 0.1042 [F91]. Relative change was -0.2402 [F92] with interval -0.2621 [F93] to -0.2183 [F94]. This missed the preregistered flattening threshold. Spearman against scale was -1 [F95]. All 5 [F96] books agreed. Worst perplexity ratio was 1.008 [F97].
Exploratory recall stayed at 20 [F100] correct. Topic switch excess loss rose from 509.6 [F101] to 567.5 [F102] in exploration. Sealed C6 outcome was B0 [F103]. Sealed rise was 0.0177 [F104] with interval 0.005412 [F105] to 0.02959 [F106]. 8 [F107] books rose. Random adapter rise was -0.0006696 [F108]. Perplexity ratio was 1.009 [F110].
C7 outcome was M1 [F111]. Full change was -0.268 [F112]. Share from layer 2 [F113] q k v alone was 0.7971 [F113]. Share from other 29 [F114] modules was 0.2191 [F114]. Interval was 0.7818 [F115] to 0.8115 [F116]. All 5 [F119] books agreed. Perplexity ratio was 1.004 [F120]. Change over that layer own heads was -0.727 [F121].
Exploratory mapping resolved 458 [F130] heads. Median listening range was 32 [F131] tokens. Upper percentile was 614.4 [F132] tokens. Median tilt was 0.1755 [F133] in local layers and 0.04079 [F134] in global layers. Muting short range heads raised loss by 1.347 [F140] versus control max 0.3244 [F141]. Muting long range heads raised loss by 0.2048 [F143] versus control max 0.4677 [F144].

reply:
The model favors slow patterns. That means long range structure passes more strongly than rapid wiggles. We inject a faint sine wave after the early stage and track how later heads respond. The sealed sweep returned T for C1. Response rose steadily with period, and the shortest drive kept only about 35 percent [F8] of the peak gain. This pattern held across book sets.

No built-in knob could flatten the tilt. That means the bias resists simple inference settings. Scaling global and local layers returned K0 for C2. Boosting selected heads returned K0 for C3. Changing window size and rotary base both returned D0 for C4, and shuffled text kept the tilt with outcome A for C4. Shifts were small and inconsistent.

A trained adapter can dial the tilt down, but it missed its goal. That means control is possible yet limited. The sealed training test returned L0 for C5. At full strength the tilt change was -24 percent [F92], just short of the preregistered bar. General text quality stayed close, with worst perplexity ratio 1.008 [F97]. The sealed behavior test returned B0 for C6, with topic switch loss rising only 2 percent [F104].

The dial acts locally. That means a small early circuit carries the effect. The sealed localization returned M1 for C7. The early query key value block alone supplied 80 percent [F113] of the full tilt change. Its effect on its own heads was -73 percent [F121]. Other modules contributed little.

Exploratory maps point to diverse heads. That means some heads listen far while most listen near. This part is exploratory. Median listening range was 32 [F131] tokens, while the upper end reached 614 [F132] tokens. Short range heads mattered more for loss in exploratory mutes. What remains open is whether a stronger dial can flatten the tilt without harm and how far range behavior truly shifts.

  55  def sha_array(a) -> str:
  56      return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes()).hexdigest()

  59  def sha_file(path: str) -> str:
  60      h = hashlib.sha256()
  61      with open(path, "rb") as fh:
  62          for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
  63              h.update(chunk)
  64      return h.hexdigest()

  67  def write_json(path: str, obj, indent=None):
  68      """Atomic: a file either exists complete or not at all. Never overwrites."""
  69      if os.path.exists(path):
  70          raise SystemExit(f"{path} exists; raw results are never overwritten.")
  71      tmp = path + ".tmp"
  72      with open(tmp, "w") as fh:
  73          json.dump(obj, fh, indent=indent)
  74          fh.flush()
  75          os.fsync(fh.fileno())
  76      os.replace(tmp, path)

  87  def condition_modules(spec, names) -> dict:
  88      """Which adapter modules are on under each condition: "all", or a list from the sealed spec that must name
  89      adapter modules, without repeats. BASE runs at scale 0, so its set does not change the model."""
  90      out = {}
  91      for c in ORDER:
  92          mods = spec["conditions"][c]["modules"]
  93          if mods == "all":
  94              out[c] = list(names)
  95              continue
  96          missing = [m for m in mods if m not in names]
  97          if missing or not mods or len(set(mods)) != len(mods):
  98              raise SystemExit(f"{c} modules not all in the adapter (or empty or repeated): {missing}")
  99          out[c] = [n for n in names if n in mods]
 100      if len({tuple(v) for c, v in out.items() if c != "BASE"}) != len(ORDER) - 1:
 101          raise SystemExit("two conditions switch on the same modules")
 102      return out

 108  def check_no_placeholders(obj, where="spec"):
 109      """A sealed spec must hold no placeholder anywhere (C6 v1 was sealed with one and could not run)."""
 110      if isinstance(obj, dict):
 111          for k, v in obj.items():
 112              check_no_placeholders(v, f"{where}.{k}")
 113      elif isinstance(obj, list):
 114          for i, v in enumerate(obj):
 115              check_no_placeholders(v, f"{where}[{i}]")
 116      elif isinstance(obj, str) and any(p in obj for p in PLACEHOLDERS):
 117          raise SystemExit(f"{where} still holds a placeholder ({obj.strip()[:40]}); the sealed spec is not runnable")

 121      named = sorted(k for k, v in spec["conditions"].items() if isinstance(v, dict) and "scale" in v)
 122      if named != sorted(ORDER):

 124      sc = {c: float(spec["conditions"][c]["scale"]) for c in ORDER}

 132      def __init__(self, ledger_root: str, seal_hash: str, cap_s: float):
 133          os.makedirs(ledger_root, exist_ok=True)
 134          self.path = os.path.join(ledger_root, f"{TAG}_{seal_hash[:12]}.jsonl")
 135          self.cap_s = cap_s
 136          self.seconds = 0.0
 137          if os.path.exists(self.path):
 138              for line in open(self.path):
 139                  if line.strip():
 140                      self.seconds += json.loads(line)["seconds"]
 141          self.mark = time.time()
 142          self.last_pass = 0.0
 143  
 144      def add(self, what: str):
 145          t = time.time()
 146          dt = t - self.mark
 147          self.mark = t
 148          self.seconds += dt
 149          with open(self.path, "a") as fh:
 150              fh.write(json.dumps({"utc": now(), "what": what, "seconds": round(dt, 3)}) + "\n")
 151              fh.flush()
 152              os.fsync(fh.fileno())
 153          return dt
 154  
 155      def check(self, upcoming_s: float = None):
 156          upcoming = self.last_pass if upcoming_s is None else upcoming_s
 157          if self.seconds + upcoming > self.cap_s:
 158              raise SystemExit(f"Budget cap: {self.seconds / 3600:.2f} wall hours used of {self.cap_s / 3600:.2f}, "
 159                               f"{upcoming / 3600:.2f} more needed. Stopping as the sealed criteria require.")

 172  class Session:
 173      """Glimmer with the frozen C5 adapter (hash checked) and C5's measurement hooks. Conditions switch the scale and
 174      which adapter modules are on (an off module has its B factor set to zero; switching back restores the saved B)."""
 175  
 176      def __init__(self, spec, seal_hash, code, ledger, args, allow_unfilled=False):
 177          self.repo = os.path.abspath(args.repo)
 178          self.spec, self.seal_hash, self.code, self.ledger = spec, seal_hash, code, ledger
 179          try:
 180              self.texts = glimmer.load_texts(spec, args.manifest, os.path.dirname(args.manifest))
 181              glimmer.configure_determinism()
 182              self.model, self.decoder, self.layers, self.tok, self.platform = glimmer.load(spec, args.weights)
 183          except BaseException:
 184              self.ledger.add("startup failed")
 185              raise
 186          self.ledger.add("startup and model load")
 187          self._setup(allow_unfilled)
 188  
 189      def _reference_input(self) -> torch.Tensor:
 190          x = torch.tensor([self.tok(self.texts[PHASE_A_BOOK], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][:2048]],
 191                           device=self.device)
 192          seen = []
 193          h = self.layers[CHECK_LAYER].self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(
 194              lambda m, a: seen.append(a[0][0].detach().clone()))
 195          try:
 196              with torch.inference_mode():
 197                  self.decoder(input_ids=x, use_cache=False)
 198          finally:
 199              h.remove()
 200          return seen[0]
 201  
 202      def _setup(self, allow_unfilled=False):
 203          """Reference before the adapter, then the adapter (hash checked), then conditions, window, grid, hooks."""
 204          check_condition_spec(self.spec)
 205          self.T = self.spec["inputs"]["length_tokens"]
 206          self.t1 = metrics.WINDOW_START
 207          self.grid = self.spec["drive"]["periods_N"]
 208          self.layer_ids = list(range(2, len(self.layers)))
 209          self.global_ids = self.platform["global_layers"]
 210          self.device = next(self.model.parameters()).device
 211          self.unadapted_ref = self._reference_input()
 212          ad_spec = self.spec["adapter"]
 213          path = os.path.join(self.repo, ad_spec["file"])
 214          self.adapter_sha = sha_file(path)
 215          if allow_unfilled and ad_spec["sha256"] == "FILL_AT_SEAL":
 216              print(f"== smoke: the adapter's sha256 is {self.adapter_sha}; fill it into the spec before sealing")
 217          elif self.adapter_sha != ad_spec["sha256"]:
 218              raise SystemExit(f"adapter {ad_spec['file']} sha256 {self.adapter_sha} differs from the sealed {ad_spec['sha256']}")
 219          ad = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu")
 220          names, params = P.attach_lora(self.layers, ad_spec["layers"], ad_spec["rank"], ad_spec["alpha"],
 221                                        family=ad_spec["family"])
 222          if names != ad["modules"]:
 223              raise SystemExit("the adapter's modules differ from the sealed family and layers")
 224          with torch.no_grad():
 225              for (a, b), pa, pb in zip(zip(ad["A"], ad["B"]), params[0::2], params[1::2]):
 226                  pa.copy_(a.to(pa.device)); pb.copy_(b.to(pb.device))
 227          for p in params:
 228              p.requires_grad_(False)
 229          self.adapter_modules = names
 230          self.params = params
 231          self.saved_B = [b.detach().clone() for b in params[1::2]]
 232          self.on = condition_modules(self.spec, names)
 233          self.condition = None
 234          P.LoRALinear.scale = 0.0
 235          hidden = self.decoder.config.hidden_size
 236          g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
 237          d = torch.randn(hidden, generator=g, dtype=torch.float32)
 238          d = d / d.norm()
 239          self.direction_sha = sha_array(d.numpy())
 240          self.direction = d.to(self.device)
 241          self.injector = WaveInjector(self.layers[1], self.direction)
 242          self.norms = ResidualNormProbe(self.layers[1])
 243          self.probe = HeadProbe(self.layers, self.layer_ids, n_heads=32, t1=self.t1)
 244          self.head = self.model.get_output_embeddings()
 245          self.softcap = getattr(self.decoder.config, "final_logit_softcapping", None)
 246          self.multiplier = getattr(self.decoder.config, "output_multiplier", None)
 247          full_text = getattr(getattr(self.model, "config", None), "text_config", None)
 248          if full_text is not None:
 249              if self.softcap is None or self.multiplier is None:
 250                  raise SystemExit("final_logit_softcapping or output_multiplier missing from the text config")
 251              if (self.softcap, self.multiplier) != (full_text.final_logit_softcapping, full_text.output_multiplier):
 252                  raise SystemExit("softcap or multiplier differs between the decoder config and the full model's text_config")
 253          self.keep_hidden = False
 254          self.last_hidden = None
 255  
 256      def set_condition(self, cond):
 257          on = set(self.on[cond])
 258          with torch.no_grad():
 259              for n, b, s in zip(self.adapter_modules, self.params[1::2], self.saved_B):
 260                  if n in on:
 261                      b.copy_(s)
 262                  else:
 263                      b.zero_()
 264          P.LoRALinear.scale = float(self.spec["conditions"][cond]["scale"])
 265          self.condition = cond
 266  
 267      def adapter_checks(self) -> dict:
 268          """BASE must reproduce the unadapted model bit for bit (layer 10 o_proj input, 2,048 tokens of book 74); every
 269          other condition must change it and differ from every other condition; FULL again after the masked conditions
 270          must reproduce the first FULL bit for bit, and BASE again the first BASE."""
 271          self.probe.mode = None
 272          x = {}
 273          try:
 274              for cond in ORDER:
 275                  self.set_condition(cond)
 276                  x[cond] = self._reference_input()
 277              self.set_condition("FULL"); full_again = self._reference_input()
 278              self.set_condition("BASE"); base_again = self._reference_input()
 279          finally:
 280              self.set_condition("BASE")
 281          others = [c for c in ORDER if c != "BASE"]
 282          out = {"base_equals_unadapted": bool(torch.equal(x["BASE"], self.unadapted_ref))}
 283          out.update({f"{c.lower()}_changes": bool((x[c] != x["BASE"]).any()) for c in others})
 284          out["all_conditions_distinct"] = all(bool((x[a] != x[b]).any()) for i, a in enumerate(others) for b in others[i + 1:])
 285          out["full_restored"] = bool(torch.equal(full_again, x["FULL"]))
 286          out["base_restored"] = bool(torch.equal(base_again, x["BASE"]))
 287          out["as_expected"] = all(out.values())
 288          out["modules_on"] = {c: len(v) for c, v in self.on.items()}
 289          return out
 290  
 291      def logits(self, h):
 292          x = self.head(h)
 293          if self.multiplier is not None:
 294              x = x * self.multiplier
 295          if self.softcap:
 296              x = torch.tanh(x / self.softcap) * self.softcap
 297          return x.float()
 298  
 299      def logits_check(self) -> dict:
 300          self.probe.mode = None
 301          self.set_condition("BASE")
 302          x = torch.tensor([self.tok(self.texts[PHASE_A_BOOK], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][:2048]],
 303                           device=self.device)
 304          with torch.inference_mode():
 305              ref = self.model(input_ids=x, use_cache=False).logits[0].float()
 306              ours = self.logits(self.decoder(input_ids=x, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state[0])
 307          diff, scale = float((ours - ref).abs().max()), float(ref.abs().max())
 308          return {"max_abs_diff": diff, "max_abs_logit": scale, "tolerance": LOGIT_TOL * scale,
 309                  "as_expected": bool(diff <= LOGIT_TOL * scale)}
 310  
 311      def ids(self, gid):
 312          raw = np.asarray(self.tok(self.texts[gid], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][: self.T], dtype=np.int64)
 313          assert len(raw) == self.T
 314          return torch.tensor(raw[None, :], device=self.device), sha_array(raw.astype(np.int32))
 315  
 316      def forward(self, ids, what: str):
 317          assert ids.shape[0] == 1, "batch size must be 1"
 318          self.ledger.check()
 319          self.ledger.add(f"before {what}")
 320          with torch.inference_mode():
 321              out = self.decoder(input_ids=ids, use_cache=False)
 322              if self.keep_hidden:
 323                  self.last_hidden = out.last_hidden_state[0]
 324          if torch.cuda.is_available():
 325              torch.cuda.synchronize()
 326          self.ledger.last_pass = self.ledger.add(what)
 327  
 328      def perplexity(self, ids) -> float:
 329          h, tgt = self.last_hidden, ids[0]
 330          total, count = 0.0, 0
 331          with torch.inference_mode():
 332              for s in range(PPL_FROM, self.T - 1, PPL_CHUNK):
 333                  e = min(s + PPL_CHUNK, self.T - 1)
 334                  lp = self.logits(h[s:e]).log_softmax(-1)
 335                  total -= float(lp.gather(1, tgt[s + 1:e + 1, None]).sum())
 336                  count += e - s
 337          self.last_hidden = None
 338          return float(np.exp(total / count))
 339  
 340      def baseline(self, ids):
 341          self.injector.disarm()
 342          self.probe.mode = "record"
 343          self.norms.armed = True
 344          self.keep_hidden = True
 345          try:
 346              self.forward(ids, "undriven")
 347          finally:
 348              self.norms.armed = False
 349              self.keep_hidden = False
 350          return float(np.median(self.norms.norms)), self.perplexity(ids)
 351  
 352      def measure(self, ids, N, amplitude, phase, what):
 353          cos_b, sin_b = self.probe.set_frequencies(N, self.T, self.device)
 354          w = drive(N, self.T, amplitude, phase)
 355          self.injector.arm(w)
 356          self.probe.mode = "measure"
 357          try:
 358              self.forward(ids, what)
 359          finally:
 360              self.injector.disarm()
 361          out = self.probe.collect()
 362          out["input_mag"] = float(metrics.component(self.injector.realized[self.t1:], cos_b[:, :1], sin_b[:, :1])[0])
 363          out["input_mag_nominal"] = float(metrics.component(w[self.t1:], cos_b[:, :1], sin_b[:, :1])[0])
 364          out["realized"] = dict(self.injector.stats, realized_over_nominal=out["input_mag"] / out["input_mag_nominal"])
 365          return out
 366  
 367      def sham_differences(self, ids) -> int:
 368          self.injector.arm(np.zeros(self.T))
 369          self.probe.mode = "zero_check"
 370          try:
 371              self.forward(ids, "sham")
 372          finally:
 373              self.injector.disarm()
 374          total = int(sum(self.probe.result.values()))
 375          self.probe.result = {}
 376          return total
 377  
 378      def record(self, gid, token_sha):
 379          return {"conditions": {c: {"scale": float(self.spec["conditions"][c]["scale"]), "modules_on": self.on[c]}
 380                                 for c in ORDER},
 381                  "adapter_sha256": self.adapter_sha, "adapter_modules": self.adapter_modules,
 382                  "softcap": self.softcap, "output_multiplier": self.multiplier, "sealed_file": SEALED,
 383                  "seal_sha256": self.seal_hash, "code_sha256": self.code, "platform": self.platform,
 384                  "gutenberg_id": gid,
 385                  "text_sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.texts[gid].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() if gid is not None else None,
 386                  "token_ids_sha256": token_sha, "tokenizer": type(self.tok).__name__,
 387                  "direction_seed": 0, "direction_sha256": self.direction_sha,
 388                  "drive": {"form": "amplitude * cos(2 pi t / N + phase) at every token t", "phase_main": PHASE_MAIN},
 389                  "window": [self.t1, self.T], "T": self.T, "layers_measured": self.layer_ids}

 449  def phase_a(s: Session, out_dir: str):
 450      """Setup checks, then linearity and power under every condition on book 74 at a = 0.1, N = 2 and 4096."""
 451      remaining = (PHASE_A_PASSES + n_books(s.spec) * passes_per_book(s.grid)) * s.spec["budget"]["seconds_per_pass_estimate"]
 452      s.ledger.check(remaining)
 453      t_phase = time.time()
 454      setup_failed = None
 455      try:
 456          ad_check = s.adapter_checks()
 457          print(f"   adapter and condition checks: {ad_check}", flush=True)
 458          logit_check = s.logits_check()
 459          print(f"   perplexity path: max |logit difference| {logit_check['max_abs_diff']:.4g} "
 460                f"(max |logit| {logit_check['max_abs_logit']:.4g}); as expected: {logit_check['as_expected']}", flush=True)
 461          failed_checks = ((["adapter"] if not ad_check["as_expected"] else [])
 462                           + (["perplexity path"] if not logit_check["as_expected"] else []))
 463          if failed_checks:
 464              write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json"),
 465                         {"phase": "A", "finished_utc": now(), "adapter_checks": ad_check, "logits_check": logit_check,
 466                          "stopped": f"setup checks failed: {failed_checks}", "outcome_if_stopped": "U",
 467                          "sham_differences": None, "rows": [], "chosen_a": None, "record": s.record(PHASE_A_BOOK, None)},
 468                         indent=2)
 469              setup_failed = failed_checks
 470              raise SystemExit(f"C8 is not run, as sealed: setup checks failed: {failed_checks}. Outcome U.")
 471          rows, sham = [], None
 472          ids, base_sha = s.ids(PHASE_A_BOOK)
 473          for cond in ORDER:
 474              s.set_condition(cond)
 475              m, ppl = s.baseline(ids)
 476              if sham is None:
 477                  sham = s.sham_differences(ids)
 478                  if sham != 0:
 479                      raise RuntimeError(f"Phase A sham differed in {sham} values. Determinism or hooks are broken.")
 480              row = {"condition": cond, "median_norm": m, "perplexity": ppl, "by_N": {}}
 481              for N in PHASE_A_N:
 482                  resp, snr = [], None
 483                  for k in (1, 2):
 484                      out = s.measure(ids, N, A * k * m, PHASE_MAIN, f"phaseA {cond} x{k} N={N}")
 485                      resp.append(float(out["target"].mean()))
 486                      if k == 1:
 487                          snr = metrics.aggregate_snr(out["target"], out["bin_power"], out["n_below"])
 488                  ratio = resp[1] / resp[0] if resp[0] > 0 else float("nan")
 489                  row["by_N"][N] = {"response_a": resp[0], "response_2a": resp[1], "ratio": ratio,
 490                                    "within_10pct": bool(abs(ratio / 2 - 1) <= 0.10), "snr_at_a": snr}
 491                  print(f"   {cond:<5} N={N:<5} ratio={ratio:.4f}  ({s.ledger.last_pass:.1f} s/pass)", flush=True)
 492              row["linear"] = all(v["within_10pct"] for v in row["by_N"].values())
 493              row["powered"] = bool(row["by_N"][max(PHASE_A_N)]["snr_at_a"] >= 3)
 494              rows.append(row)
 495          s.set_condition("BASE")
 496      except BaseException as e:
 497          if setup_failed is None:
 498              print(f"!! Phase A failed; record: {write_failure(out_dir, 'phaseA', e)}")
 499          raise
 500      bad = [r["condition"] for r in rows if not (r["linear"] and r["powered"])]
 501      stopped = f"not linear or underpowered under {bad}" if bad else None
 502      wall_per_pass = (time.time() - t_phase) / PHASE_A_PASSES
 503      write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json"),
 504                 {"phase": "A", "finished_utc": now(), "wall_seconds_per_pass": wall_per_pass, "book": PHASE_A_BOOK,
 505                  "a": A, "adapter_checks": ad_check, "logits_check": logit_check, "stopped": stopped,
 506                  "outcome_if_stopped": "U" if stopped else None, "sham_differences": sham, "rows": rows,
 507                  "chosen_a": None if stopped else A, "seconds_per_pass_last": s.ledger.last_pass,
 508                  "record": s.record(PHASE_A_BOOK, base_sha)}, indent=2)
 509      projected = n_books(s.spec) * passes_per_book(s.grid) * wall_per_pass / 3600

 590  def admit(raw_root: str, out_dir: str, seal_hash: str, spec, restart_reason: str = None, new: bool = True) -> list:
 591      """New run: refused if this run id exists, if any run under the seal is complete or was stopped by rule, or if any
 592      run exists and no written reason is given; writes STARTED.json. Continue: needs STARTED.json under this seal,
 593      must be the newest run, refused if another run is complete; a Phase A failure or a book attempt needs a reason."""
 594      runs = runs_under_seal(raw_root, seal_hash, spec) if os.path.isdir(raw_root) else []
 595      me = os.path.basename(out_dir)
 596      others = [r for r in runs if r["run_id"] != me]
 597      final = [r["run_id"] for r in others if r["state"] in ("complete", "stopped")]
 598      if new:
 599          if os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json")):
 600              raise SystemExit("This run id already started; raw results are never overwritten.")
 601          if final:
 602              raise SystemExit(f"A run under this seal is complete or was stopped by rule: {final}. No new run.")
 603          if others and not restart_reason:
 604              raise SystemExit(f"Runs already started under this seal: {others}. A new run is allowed only after an "
 605                               f"infrastructure failure; pass --restart-reason and keep the old run.")
 606          os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
 607          write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json"),
 608                     {"utc": now(), "seal_sha256": seal_hash, "restart_reason": restart_reason, "earlier_runs": others},
 609                     indent=1)
 610          return others
 611      started = os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json")
 612      if not os.path.exists(started) or json.load(open(started)).get("seal_sha256") != seal_hash:
 613          raise SystemExit(f"{out_dir} has no STARTED.json under this seal.")
 614      mine = next(r for r in runs if r["run_id"] == me)
 615      newer = [r["run_id"] for r in others if (r["started_utc"] or "", r["run_id"]) > (mine["started_utc"] or "", me)]
 616      if newer:
 617          raise SystemExit(f"A newer run under this seal has started: {newer}. Only the newest run may continue.")
 618      if final:
 619          raise SystemExit(f"Another run under this seal is complete or was stopped by rule: {final}.")
 620      if mine["state"] == "stopped":
 621          raise SystemExit("This run was stopped by rule in Phase A; C8 is not run, as sealed.")
 622      if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json")) and \
 623              glob.glob(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.FAILED.*.json")) and not restart_reason:
 624          raise SystemExit("Phase A failed before in this run. A retry needs --restart-reason; the record is kept.")
 625      return others

  81  def curve(book, grid, cond, keep_layer=None):
  82      """Mean gain per N over every measured head (or over the heads of layers keep_layer accepts), and the
  83      whole-model SNR per N."""
  84      layer_ids = book["record"]["layers_measured"]
  85      keep = None if keep_layer is None else np.array([keep_layer(l) for l in layer_ids])
  86      out, snr = np.empty(len(grid)), np.empty(len(grid))
  87      for j, N in enumerate(grid):
  88          gain, _, snr[j] = cell_quantities(book["per_condition"][cond][str(N)])
  89          out[j] = (metrics.group_means(gain, layer_ids, book["global_layers"])["whole"] if keep is None
  90                    else float(gain[keep].mean()))
  91      return out, snr

  94  def set_tilts(curves: dict, grid) -> tuple:
  95      """Set-level tilt per condition, each fit over the periods valid (median SNR >= 3 over books) under every
  96      condition."""
  97      valid = {c: np.median(np.stack([x[1] for x in curves[c]]), axis=0) >= VALID_SNR for c in CONDITIONS}
  98      common = np.logical_and.reduce([valid[c] for c in CONDITIONS])
  99      tilts = {c: metrics_c2.tilt(grid, np.mean(np.stack([x[0] for x in curves[c]]), axis=0), common)
 100               for c in CONDITIONS}
 101      return tilts, common, valid

 123  def reproduction(books, grid, c1_run_dir) -> dict:
 124      """BASE runs C1 v5's computation on the same set B tokens. Reported, expected 0, not a gate: the maximum relative
 125      difference of per-head target magnitudes, of the input component per period, and of the amplitude reference
 126      (C1 v5's median_norm) from C1 v5's raw files. Status "complete" only if every book and period was compared."""
 127      rel = lambda x, y: float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64) - np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64))
 128                                      / np.maximum(np.abs(np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)), 1e-30)))
 129      if not c1_run_dir or not os.path.isdir(c1_run_dir):
 130          return {"status": "not found", "c1_run": c1_run_dir}
 131      worst = {"target": 0.0, "input_mag": 0.0, "amplitude_reference": 0.0}
 132      compared, missing, cells = [], [], 0
 133      for b in books:
 134          p = os.path.join(c1_run_dir, f"book_{b['set']}_{b['gutenberg_id']}.json")
 135          if not os.path.exists(p):
 136              missing.append(b["gutenberg_id"])
 137              continue
 138          c1 = json.load(open(p))
 139          compared.append(b["gutenberg_id"])
 140          worst["amplitude_reference"] = max(worst["amplitude_reference"],
 141                                             rel([b["amplitude_reference"]["BASE"]], [c1["median_norm"]]))
 142          for N in grid:
 143              x, y = b["per_condition"]["BASE"][str(N)], c1["per_N"][str(N)]
 144              worst["target"] = max(worst["target"], rel(x["target"], y["target"]))
 145              worst["input_mag"] = max(worst["input_mag"], rel([x["input_mag"]], [y["input_mag"]]))
 146              cells += 1
 147      full = not missing and cells == len(books) * len(grid)
 148      return {"status": "complete" if full else "incomplete", "books_compared": compared, "books_missing": missing,
 149              "cells_compared": cells, "max_relative_difference": worst["target"],
 150              "max_relative_difference_input_mag": worst["input_mag"],
 151              "max_relative_difference_amplitude_reference": worst["amplitude_reference"],
 152              "c1_run": os.path.basename(c1_run_dir)}

   1  """C8 metrics: does one matrix, layer 2's v_proj, carry a majority of the C5 dial's tilt change, specifically?
   2  Implements criteria/sealed/c8-glimmer-one-matrix-dial-v1.yaml. Tilts come from metrics_c2.tilt. Pure Python.
   3  """
   4  CONDITIONS = ("BASE", "FULL", "QKV2", "V2", "QK2", "V4")
   5  MIN_FULL_CHANGE = 0.15          # FULL must flatten the tilt by at least 15 percent (Muse Wonder's floor)
   6  MIN_SHARE_V2 = 0.50             # V2's change must be at least half of FULL's: a majority from 1 of 32 matrices ...
   7  MAX_SHARE_V2 = 1.40             # ... without overshooting FULL by more than 40 percent
   8  MAX_ABS_SHARE_V4 = 0.30         # the matched control, layer 4's v, must stay within 30 percent of FULL in either direction
   9  MIN_BOOKS = 4                   # of the 5 books, at least 4 must agree (book rule below)
  10  BOOK_MIN_SHARE = 0.30           # a book agrees if FULL and V2 both flatten it and V2's change is >= 30 percent of FULL's
  11  
  12  
  13  def shares(tilts: dict) -> dict:
  14      """Each masked condition's tilt change from BASE as a fraction of FULL's change. None if undefined."""
  15      if any(tilts.get(c) is None for c in CONDITIONS) or tilts["FULL"] == tilts["BASE"]:
  16          return {c: None for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}
  17      full = tilts["FULL"] - tilts["BASE"]
  18      return {c: (tilts[c] - tilts["BASE"]) / full for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}
  19  
  20  
  21  def book_agrees(t: dict) -> bool:
  22      if any(t.get(c) is None for c in ("BASE", "FULL", "V2")):
  23          return False
  24      dv, df = t["V2"] - t["BASE"], t["FULL"] - t["BASE"]
  25      return bool(dv < 0 and df < 0 and dv / df >= BOOK_MIN_SHARE)
  26  
  27  
  28  def one_matrix_outcome(tilts: dict, book_tilts: list) -> dict:
  29      """tilts: set-level tilt per condition; book_tilts: per book, its tilt per condition (None where undefined).
  30  
  31      U: a tilt undefined, tilt(BASE) not positive, or FULL does not flatten by at least 15 percent.
  32      sufficient: 0.50 <= share(V2) <= 1.40 and at least 4 of 5 books agree.
  33      specific: |share(V4)| <= 0.30.
  34      V1 one-matrix dial: sufficient and specific. V2S sufficient, not specific. V0 not sufficient.
  35      """
  36      if any(tilts.get(c) is None for c in CONDITIONS):
  37          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "a tilt is undefined", "tilts": dict(tilts)}
  38      if tilts["BASE"] <= 0:
  39          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "tilt(BASE) is not positive", "tilts": dict(tilts)}
  40      full_change = (tilts["FULL"] - tilts["BASE"]) / tilts["BASE"]
  41      if full_change > -MIN_FULL_CHANGE:
  42          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "FULL does not flatten the tilt by at least 15 percent",
  43                  "full_change": full_change, "tilts": dict(tilts)}
  44      sh = shares(tilts)
  45      books = sum(1 for t in book_tilts if book_agrees(t))
  46      in_range = MIN_SHARE_V2 <= sh["V2"] <= MAX_SHARE_V2
  47      sufficient = in_range and books >= MIN_BOOKS
  48      specific = abs(sh["V4"]) <= MAX_ABS_SHARE_V4
  49      outcome = ("V1" if specific else "V2S") if sufficient else "V0"
  50      reason = None
  51      if not sufficient:
  52          reason = "; ".join(r for r, bad in (
  53              (f"share(V2) {sh['V2']:.3f} outside [{MIN_SHARE_V2}, {MAX_SHARE_V2}]", not in_range),
  54              (f"{books} of 5 books agree, fewer than {MIN_BOOKS}", books < MIN_BOOKS)) if bad)
  55      elif not specific:
  56          reason = f"|share(V4)| {abs(sh['V4']):.3f} above {MAX_ABS_SHARE_V4}"
  57      return {"outcome": outcome, "reason": reason, "full_change": full_change,
  58              **{f"share_{c}": sh[c] for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}, "share_V2_in_range": bool(in_range),
  59              "books_agree_V2": books, "sufficient": bool(sufficient), "specific": bool(specific),
  60              "share_V2_of_QKV2": sh["V2"] / sh["QKV2"] if sh["QKV2"] else None,
  61              "additivity_V2_plus_QK2_over_QKV2": (sh["V2"] + sh["QK2"]) / sh["QKV2"] if sh["QKV2"] else None,
  62              "tilts": dict(tilts)}

reply:
The model favors slow patterns. That means long range signals pass best. We add a small sine wave after an early layer and measure how strongly later heads follow it for periods from 2 [F4] to 4096 [F5] tokens. The sealed shape test for C1 returned T. The shortest period reaches only 35 percent [F8] of peak response.

No built in setting could turn this down. That means the bias is stubborn. Changing global and local gains left tilt flat for C2, which returned K0. Boosting chosen heads also failed for C3, which returned K0. Changing window size and rotary base failed for C4, which returned D0 for both levers. The text control for C4 returned A.

A trained dial can flatten tilt but missed its goal with little behavior change. That means control is possible at small cost. The sealed training test for C5 returned L0, with tilt down by only -24 percent [F92] at full strength. General cost stayed tiny at 1.008 [F97]. The sealed behavior test for C6 returned B0, with only a 2 percent [F104] rise in topic switch loss.

The dial acts through a tiny early site. That means an early tweak spreads widely. The sealed localization test for C7 returned M1, with about 80 percent [F113] of the full change from one early attention block alone. The follow up proposed by Muse Wonder for C8 returned O1, with about 57 percent [F125] from a single value matrix alone.

The exploratory head map suggests a mix of ranges. That means average tilt hides variety. Exploratory fits show median range of 32 [F148] tokens with a long tail to 614.4 [F149] tokens. These findings are exploratory only. Open work is why the bias resists built in controls, whether stronger training can hold safely, and how range mix shapes real use.

Using the results on the fact sheet, propose the single most informative next experiment the lab can run in under 2 GPU hours on one 96 GB GPU (BF16) with the existing harness. Available tools: the tilt measurement at 32,768 tokens (about 13 s per pass, 7 periods, shams, 5 books per set); the frozen C5 adapter at any scale with any subset of its 32 modules switched on (layers 2 to 5: q, k, v, gate and o projections and MLP); muting chosen attention heads; per-token next-token loss on held-out book text; the drive direction, amplitude and injection layer; the local window size and RoPE base; shuffled or repeated-token text; and, as a separately labeled side check only, the same model loaded in 4-bit NF4. Book sets A, B and C hold 5 books each; text beyond token 70,000 has not been used. No new training. The proposal must test something the facts leave open, fix its pass rule before any data with a numeric threshold, and include a control. The conditions must include the unmodified model (dial at 0) as the baseline, and use dial scale 2, the sealed scale. The control must be an intervention of the same kind and size that should NOT produce the effect if the hypothesis is right (for example, the same modules in a different layer). Design numbers (thresholds, scales, counts, hours) are your own choices: write them plainly, without a citation, and justify each threshold in one clause. Cite a fact only when you quote a result. Reply with one JSON object only, no other text, with exactly these keys: title, question, prediction, intervention, conditions, control, books, primary_metric, pass_rule, failure_meaning, gpu_hours_estimate, risks, why_this_next. conditions and risks are lists of strings; gpu_hours_estimate is a number; the rest are strings. Write in plain, short sentences. Never use em dashes. Results you quote must carry the id of the fact that holds that exact number, like 0.797 [F113]; never cite a fact for a design number or a label.

reply:
1. Control is mismatched in position. Layer 2 heads carry most of the dial change and a later layer cannot reach them, so omitting layer 4 must retain more change even if modules are equal. Fix by changing the primary metric to layers 5 to 51 only where both can act downstream, or by using another omit-one-module inside layer 2 as the positional control.

2. The new segment is not pristine. Tokens 32768 to 65535 in set C overlap the exploratory window 60000 to 68191 in set C, which weakens the claim of new text. Fix by using set A books for the 32768 to 65535 segment, since set A was not used in that exploratory window and the segment is disjoint from the first 32768 tokens.

3. Pass rule does not score the replication conditions. Failure meaning refers to failure of the full dial or the single module check on this segment but gives no numeric bar for either. Fix by adding explicit bars for those conditions, for example full change negative and single v share in a stated range, or drop condition 3 to save budget.

4. Books are underspecified. Set C had 15 books in C1 but only 5 in C8. Fix by listing the same 5 book IDs as C8.

5. Quoted numbers match the cited facts and the retained share is correctly defined as a share of the full dial change on the same segment. Segment length and start satisfy the length and start limits. Layer types match as local, and budget math at 5 books times 5 conditions times 9 passes times 13.5 s is about 0.84 h so 1.1 h is conservative.

Verdict: FIXABLE

Lab constraints:
Lab constraints (fixed facts about the setup, not results):
- Model: Muse Glimmer-30B, 52 decoder layers. Global layers (full attention, no position encoding): 3, 7, 11, ..., 51.
  All others are local (2,048-token sliding window, RoPE). A control in another layer should match the layer type.
- The tilt is measured over attention heads in layers 2 to 51. A change made in layer L directly changes layer L's own
  heads and can only change later layers. Layer 2's own heads carry a large part of the dial's change (C7 under the
  full dial: layer 2's heads -74 percent, layers 3 to 51 -13 percent), so a control placed in a later layer cannot
  reach them.
- A measurement uses the first 32,768 tokens of a book (or another 32,768-token segment), with an 8,192-token burn-in.
  The shortest of the 15 books has 94,774 tokens, so a 32,768-token segment must start at or before token 62,006.
  First 32,768 tokens already measured with the adapter: set A (C5), set B (C7), set C (C8). Exploratory probes used
  tokens 60,000 to 68,191 (set C; C6 used sets B and C there) and the band-mute probe 70,000 to 78,191 (sets A and B).
- Cost: one 32,768-token pass takes about 13.5 s; per book and condition, 9 passes (undriven, sham, 7 periods).
- Shares: say what the share is a share of. A share of layer 2 attention's change is not a share of the full dial.
- The C5 adapter has 32 modules in layers 2 to 5 (q, k, v, gate and o projections and the MLP's three), rank 8.

 173    read_point: forward pre-hook on self_attn.o_proj (gated head outputs, 32 heads x 128), layers 2 to 51 as in C1 v5
 174    response: driven minus undriven head output, per head, per token, computed in float32
 175    window: >
 176      One window for every N: segment positions [8192, 32768), W = 24576. Every period N divides W,
 177      so the target bin k0 = W / N is a whole number (smallest k0 = 6 at N = 4096). The
 178      first 8192 positions are a burn-in, four times the sliding window.
 179    operator: >
 180      Per head dimension: remove the least-squares line a + b t over the window, multiply by
 181      a periodic Hann window, and take the Fourier sum at each analysis frequency. The same
 182      operator is applied to the input drive, so a pass-through head has gain 1 (tested to 1e-5 in float32).
 183      Line removal biases gain by under 0.1 percent on this grid (tested).
 184    target_component: per head, the norm over its 128 dims of the operator output at frequency 1/N
 185    input_component: the operator output at 1/N for the realized drive along the direction (what bfloat16 actually stored); the nominal component of w_t is recorded beside it
 186    gain: target_component divided by input_component
 187    noise_bins: >
 188      Integer bins k in (0, W / 2], excluding every bin within 1 of a multiple of k0 (DC
 189      included): the up to 8 nearest below k0 and the 8 nearest above. At N = 4096 only 3 lie
 190      below (k = 2, 3, 4); at least 3 are required. At N = 2 the target is
 191      the Nyquist bin, so the 16 nearest below are used. Hann leakage from any harmonic reaches
 192      only its two neighbor bins, which are excluded.
 193    floor_rule: >
 194      Two-sided floor = the larger of the median over the bins below k0 and the median over
 195      the bins above k0 (at N = 2, the median of all 16). Smooth drift leaks mostly into low
 196      bins, so a floor taken only above k0 would let drift pass as signal at long N (tested
 197      with log, inverse, square, square-root and exponential drifts: all stay below SNR 1).
 198    noise_floor_per_head: two-sided floor of the head's noise-bin magnitudes (diagnostics only)
 199    snr: >
 200      Whole-model SNR per book and N: sqrt(sum over all 1,600 measured heads of target power,
 201      divided by the two-sided floor of the noise-bin power summed over all heads).

Without it the dial keeps at most 60 percent over layers 2 to 51 and at most 70 percent over layers 5 to 51, while dropping layer 2's output gate (same layer) or layer 4's v_proj (same type) keeps at least 80 percent of their window's change. With C8, layer 2's v_proj is both enough for a majority and needed for a large part

  89  def condition_modules(spec, names) -> dict:
  90      """Which adapter modules are on under each condition: "all"; {"all_except": [...]}, every adapter module but the
  91      listed ones (each must be an adapter module, no repeats, at least one left on); or a list from the sealed spec
  92      that must name adapter modules, in adapter order, without repeats. BASE runs at scale 0, so its set does not
  93      change the model."""
  94      out = {}
  95      for c in ORDER:
  96          mods = spec["conditions"][c]["modules"]
  97          if mods == "all":
  98              out[c] = list(names)
  99              continue
 100          if isinstance(mods, dict):
 101              drop = mods.get("all_except")
 102              if set(mods) != {"all_except"} or not drop or len(set(drop)) != len(drop) \
 103                      or any(m not in names for m in drop) or len(drop) >= len(names):
 104                  raise SystemExit(f"{c}: all_except must list adapter modules, without repeats, leaving some on: {mods}")
 105              out[c] = [n for n in names if n not in drop]
 106              continue
 107          missing = [m for m in mods if m not in names]
 108          if missing or not mods or len(set(mods)) != len(mods):
 109              raise SystemExit(f"{c} modules not all in the adapter (or empty or repeated): {missing}")
 110          out[c] = [n for n in names if n in mods]
 111          if out[c] != list(mods):            # the analysis compares records to the sealed list in order
 112              raise SystemExit(f"{c} modules must be listed in adapter order: {out[c]}")
 113      if len({tuple(v) for c, v in out.items() if c != "BASE"}) != len(ORDER) - 1:
 114          raise SystemExit("two conditions switch on the same modules")
 115      return out

 189      def __init__(self, spec, seal_hash, code, ledger, args, allow_unfilled=False):

 191          self.spec, self.seal_hash, self.code, self.ledger = spec, seal_hash, code, ledger
 192          try:

 202      def _reference_input(self) -> torch.Tensor:
 203          x = torch.tensor([self.tok(self.texts[PHASE_A_BOOK], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][:2048]],
 204                           device=self.device)
 205          seen = []
 206          h = self.layers[CHECK_LAYER].self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(
 207              lambda m, a: seen.append(a[0][0].detach().clone()))
 208          try:
 209              with torch.inference_mode():
 210                  self.decoder(input_ids=x, use_cache=False)
 211          finally:
 212              h.remove()

 223          self.global_ids = self.platform["global_layers"]
 224          self.device = next(self.model.parameters()).device

 281      def adapter_checks(self) -> dict:
 282          """BASE must reproduce the unadapted model bit for bit (layer 10 o_proj input, first 2,048 tokens of the Phase A
 283          book); every
 284          other condition must change it and differ from every other condition; FULL again after the masked conditions
 285          must reproduce the first FULL bit for bit, and BASE again the first BASE."""
 286          self.probe.mode = None
 287          x = {}
 288          try:
 289              for cond in ORDER:
 290                  self.set_condition(cond)
 291                  x[cond] = self._reference_input()
 292              self.set_condition("FULL"); full_again = self._reference_input()
 293              self.set_condition("BASE"); base_again = self._reference_input()
 294          finally:
 295              self.set_condition("BASE")
 296          others = [c for c in ORDER if c != "BASE"]
 297          out = {"base_equals_unadapted": bool(torch.equal(x["BASE"], self.unadapted_ref))}
 298          out.update({f"{c.lower()}_changes": bool((x[c] != x["BASE"]).any()) for c in others})
 299          out["all_conditions_distinct"] = all(bool((x[a] != x[b]).any()) for i, a in enumerate(others) for b in others[i + 1:])
 300          out["full_restored"] = bool(torch.equal(full_again, x["FULL"]))
 301          out["base_restored"] = bool(torch.equal(base_again, x["BASE"]))
 302          out["as_expected"] = all(out.values())
 303          out["modules_on"] = {c: len(v) for c, v in self.on.items()}
 304          return out

 306      def logits(self, h):
 307          x = self.head(h)
 308          if self.multiplier is not None:
 309              x = x * self.multiplier
 310          if self.softcap:
 311              x = torch.tanh(x / self.softcap) * self.softcap
 312          return x.float()

 314      def logits_check(self) -> dict:
 315          self.probe.mode = None
 316          self.set_condition("BASE")
 317          x = torch.tensor([self.tok(self.texts[PHASE_A_BOOK], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][:2048]],
 318                           device=self.device)
 319          with torch.inference_mode():
 320              ref = self.model(input_ids=x, use_cache=False).logits[0].float()
 321              ours = self.logits(self.decoder(input_ids=x, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state[0])
 322          diff, scale = float((ours - ref).abs().max()), float(ref.abs().max())
 323          return {"max_abs_diff": diff, "max_abs_logit": scale, "tolerance": LOGIT_TOL * scale,
 324                  "as_expected": bool(diff <= LOGIT_TOL * scale)}

 326      def ids(self, gid):
 327          """Token ids [start, start + T) of the stripped text, no BOS (the sealed segment)."""
 328          raw = np.asarray(self.tok(self.texts[gid], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"][self.start: self.start + self.T],
 329                           dtype=np.int64)
 330          if len(raw) != self.T:
 331              raise SystemExit(f"book {gid} is too short for tokens {self.start} to {self.start + self.T - 1}")
 332          return torch.tensor(raw[None, :], device=self.device), sha_array(raw.astype(np.int32))
 333  
 334      def forward(self, ids, what: str):
 335          assert ids.shape[0] == 1, "batch size must be 1"
 336          self.ledger.check()
 337          self.ledger.add(f"before {what}")
 338          with torch.inference_mode():
 339              out = self.decoder(input_ids=ids, use_cache=False)
 340              if self.keep_hidden:
 341                  self.last_hidden = out.last_hidden_state[0]
 342          if torch.cuda.is_available():
 343              torch.cuda.synchronize()
 344          self.ledger.last_pass = self.ledger.add(what)
 345  
 346      def perplexity(self, ids) -> float:
 347          h, tgt = self.last_hidden, ids[0]
 348          total, count = 0.0, 0
 349          with torch.inference_mode():
 350              for s in range(PPL_FROM, self.T - 1, PPL_CHUNK):
 351                  e = min(s + PPL_CHUNK, self.T - 1)
 352                  lp = self.logits(h[s:e]).log_softmax(-1)
 353                  total -= float(lp.gather(1, tgt[s + 1:e + 1, None]).sum())
 354                  count += e - s
 355          self.last_hidden = None
 356          return float(np.exp(total / count))
 357  
 358      def baseline(self, ids):
 359          self.injector.disarm()
 360          self.probe.mode = "record"
 361          self.norms.armed = True
 362          self.keep_hidden = True
 363          try:
 364              self.forward(ids, "undriven")
 365          finally:
 366              self.norms.armed = False
 367              self.keep_hidden = False
 368          return float(np.median(self.norms.norms)), self.perplexity(ids)

 370      def measure(self, ids, N, amplitude, phase, what):
 371          cos_b, sin_b = self.probe.set_frequencies(N, self.T, self.device)
 372          w = drive(N, self.T, amplitude, phase)
 373          self.injector.arm(w)
 374          self.probe.mode = "measure"
 375          try:
 376              self.forward(ids, what)
 377          finally:
 378              self.injector.disarm()
 379          out = self.probe.collect()
 380          out["input_mag"] = float(metrics.component(self.injector.realized[self.t1:], cos_b[:, :1], sin_b[:, :1])[0])
 381          out["input_mag_nominal"] = float(metrics.component(w[self.t1:], cos_b[:, :1], sin_b[:, :1])[0])
 382          out["realized"] = dict(self.injector.stats, realized_over_nominal=out["input_mag"] / out["input_mag_nominal"])
 383          return out

 385      def sham_differences(self, ids) -> int:
 386          self.injector.arm(np.zeros(self.T))
 387          self.probe.mode = "zero_check"
 388          try:
 389              self.forward(ids, "sham")
 390          finally:
 391              self.injector.disarm()
 392          total = int(sum(self.probe.result.values()))
 393          self.probe.result = {}
 394          return total

 467  def phase_a(s: Session, out_dir: str, restart_reason: str = None):
 468      """Setup checks, then linearity and power under every condition on the Phase A book's segment at a = 0.1,
 469      N = 2 and 4096."""
 470      remaining = (PHASE_A_PASSES + n_books(s.spec) * passes_per_book(s.grid)) * s.spec["budget"]["seconds_per_pass_estimate"]
 471      s.ledger.check(remaining)
 472      t_phase = time.time()
 473      setup_failed = None
 474      try:
 475          ad_check = s.adapter_checks()
 476          print(f"   adapter and condition checks: {ad_check}", flush=True)
 477          logit_check = s.logits_check()
 478          print(f"   perplexity path: max |logit difference| {logit_check['max_abs_diff']:.4g} "
 479                f"(max |logit| {logit_check['max_abs_logit']:.4g}); as expected: {logit_check['as_expected']}", flush=True)
 480          failed_checks = ((["adapter"] if not ad_check["as_expected"] else [])
 481                           + (["perplexity path"] if not logit_check["as_expected"] else []))
 482          if failed_checks:
 483              write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json"),
 484                         {"phase": "A", "finished_utc": now(), "restart_reason": restart_reason,
 485                          "adapter_checks": ad_check, "logits_check": logit_check,
 486                          "stopped": f"setup checks failed: {failed_checks}", "outcome_if_stopped": "U",
 487                          "sham_differences": None, "rows": [], "chosen_a": None, "record": s.record(PHASE_A_BOOK, None)},
 488                         indent=2)
 489              setup_failed = failed_checks
 490              raise SystemExit(f"C9 is not run, as sealed: setup checks failed: {failed_checks}. Outcome U.")
 491          rows, sham = [], None
 492          ids, base_sha = s.ids(PHASE_A_BOOK)
 493          for cond in ORDER:
 494              s.set_condition(cond)
 495              m, ppl = s.baseline(ids)
 496              if sham is None:
 497                  sham = s.sham_differences(ids)
 498                  if sham != 0:
 499                      raise RuntimeError(f"Phase A sham differed in {sham} values. Determinism or hooks are broken.")
 500              row = {"condition": cond, "median_norm": m, "perplexity": ppl, "by_N": {}}
 501              for N in PHASE_A_N:
 502                  resp, snr = [], None
 503                  for k in (1, 2):
 504                      out = s.measure(ids, N, A * k * m, PHASE_MAIN, f"phaseA {cond} x{k} N={N}")
 505                      resp.append(float(out["target"].mean()))
 506                      if k == 1:
 507                          snr = metrics.aggregate_snr(out["target"], out["bin_power"], out["n_below"])
 508                  ratio = resp[1] / resp[0] if resp[0] > 0 else float("nan")
 509                  row["by_N"][N] = {"response_a": resp[0], "response_2a": resp[1], "ratio": ratio,
 510                                    "within_10pct": bool(abs(ratio / 2 - 1) <= 0.10), "snr_at_a": snr}
 511                  print(f"   {cond:<5} N={N:<5} ratio={ratio:.4f}  ({s.ledger.last_pass:.1f} s/pass)", flush=True)
 512              row["linear"] = all(v["within_10pct"] for v in row["by_N"].values())
 513              row["powered"] = bool(row["by_N"][max(PHASE_A_N)]["snr_at_a"] >= 3)
 514              rows.append(row)
 515          s.set_condition("BASE")
 516      except BaseException as e:
 517          if setup_failed is None:
 518              print(f"!! Phase A failed; record: {write_failure(out_dir, 'phaseA', e)}")
 519          raise
 520      bad = [r["condition"] for r in rows if not (r["linear"] and r["powered"])]
 521      stopped = f"not linear or underpowered under {bad}" if bad else None
 522      wall_per_pass = (time.time() - t_phase) / PHASE_A_PASSES
 523      write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json"),
 524                 {"phase": "A", "finished_utc": now(), "restart_reason": restart_reason,
 525                  "earlier_failures": sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(out_dir, "*.FAILED.*.json"))),
 526                  "wall_seconds_per_pass": wall_per_pass, "book": PHASE_A_BOOK,
 527                  "a": A, "adapter_checks": ad_check, "logits_check": logit_check, "stopped": stopped,
 528                  "outcome_if_stopped": "U" if stopped else None, "sham_differences": sham, "rows": rows,
 529                  "chosen_a": None if stopped else A, "seconds_per_pass_last": s.ledger.last_pass,
 530                  "record": s.record(PHASE_A_BOOK, base_sha)}, indent=2)
 531      projected = n_books(s.spec) * passes_per_book(s.grid) * wall_per_pass / 3600
 532      print(f"== Phase B projection: {projected:.2f} hours at {wall_per_pass:.1f} wall s per pass; "
 533            f"{s.ledger.seconds / 3600:.2f} used of {s.spec['budget']['max_gpu_hours']}", flush=True)
 534      if stopped:
 535          raise SystemExit(f"C9 is not run, as sealed: {stopped}. Outcome U.")
 536      print(f"== Phase A passed under all {len(ORDER)} conditions at a = {A}; checks as expected", flush=True)

 612  def admit(raw_root: str, out_dir: str, seal_hash: str, spec, restart_reason: str = None, new: bool = True) -> list:
 613      """New run: refused if this run id exists, if any run under the seal is complete or was stopped by rule, or if any
 614      run exists and no written reason is given; writes STARTED.json. Continue: needs STARTED.json under this seal,
 615      must be the newest run, refused if another run is complete; a Phase A failure or a book attempt needs a reason."""
 616      runs = runs_under_seal(raw_root, seal_hash, spec) if os.path.isdir(raw_root) else []
 617      me = os.path.basename(out_dir)
 618      others = [r for r in runs if r["run_id"] != me]
 619      final = [r["run_id"] for r in others if r["state"] in ("complete", "stopped")]
 620      if new:
 621          if os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json")):
 622              raise SystemExit("This run id already started; raw results are never overwritten.")
 623          if final:
 624              raise SystemExit(f"A run under this seal is complete or was stopped by rule: {final}. No new run.")
 625          if others and not restart_reason:
 626              raise SystemExit(f"Runs already started under this seal: {others}. A new run is allowed only after an "
 627                               f"infrastructure failure; pass --restart-reason and keep the old run.")
 628          os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
 629          write_json(os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json"),
 630                     {"utc": now(), "seal_sha256": seal_hash, "restart_reason": restart_reason, "earlier_runs": others},
 631                     indent=1)
 632          return others
 633      started = os.path.join(out_dir, "STARTED.json")
 634      if not os.path.exists(started) or json.load(open(started)).get("seal_sha256") != seal_hash:
 635          raise SystemExit(f"{out_dir} has no STARTED.json under this seal.")
 636      mine = next(r for r in runs if r["run_id"] == me)
 637      newer = [r["run_id"] for r in others if (r["started_utc"] or "", r["run_id"]) > (mine["started_utc"] or "", me)]
 638      if newer:
 639          raise SystemExit(f"A newer run under this seal has started: {newer}. Only the newest run may continue.")
 640      if final:
 641          raise SystemExit(f"Another run under this seal is complete or was stopped by rule: {final}.")
 642      if mine["state"] == "stopped":
 643          raise SystemExit("This run was stopped by rule in Phase A; C9 is not run, as sealed.")
 644      if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, "phaseA.json")) and \
 645              glob.glob(os.path.join(out_dir, "*.FAILED.*.json")) and not restart_reason:
 646          raise SystemExit("This run has a failure record (startup or Phase A). Continuing retries Phase A and needs "
 647                           "--restart-reason; the record is kept and the reason is stamped into phaseA.json.")
 648      return others

 662      BASE and NOV2 an undriven pass, a sham and driven passes at N = 2 and 4096, and a closing sham. Prints times,
 663      memory, sham counts, finiteness and BASE perplexity only. Writes nothing to results/."""

 668      print(f"== adapter {spec['adapter']['file']}: {len(s.adapter_modules)} modules, sha256 {s.adapter_sha}")
 669      for set_name, books in spec["inputs"]["prompt_sets"].items():
 670          for g in books:

 691      shams.append(s.sham_differences(ids))
 692      s.set_condition("BASE")

 694      ok = ad["as_expected"] and lc["as_expected"] and all(x == 0 for x in shams) and finite

   1  """C9 metrics: is layer 2's v_proj necessary inside the full C5 dial, and is that specific to it?
   2  Implements criteria/sealed/c9-glimmer-necessity-v1.yaml. Tilts come from metrics_c2.tilt. Pure Python.
   3  
   4  A condition's retained share is the fraction of the full dial's tilt change it keeps:
   5      retained(X) = (tilt(X) - tilt(BASE)) / (tilt(FULL) - tilt(BASE))
   6  computed over two read windows: the main tilt (heads in layers 2 to 51) and the downstream tilt (heads in layers 5 to
   7  51, which both layer 2's and layer 4's modules can reach).
   8  """
   9  CONDITIONS = ("BASE", "FULL", "V2", "NOV2", "NOV4", "NOG2")
  10  MIN_FULL_CHANGE = 0.15          # FULL must flatten the main tilt by at least 15 percent (as C8; Muse Wonder's floor)
  11  V2_GATE_MAIN = (0.40, 1.40)     # replication gate: layer 2 v alone, main window (Muse Wonder's revised proposal)
  12  V2_GATE_DOWN = (0.20, 1.40)     # the same, downstream window
  13  MAX_RETAIN_NOV2 = 0.60          # main: without layer 2 v the dial keeps at most 60 percent (loses at least 40)
  14  MIN_RETAIN_NOG2 = 0.80          # main: without layer 2's output gate (same layer, reaches layer 2's heads) it keeps at least 80 percent
  15  MIN_BOOKS = 4                   # of 5 books, at least 4 keep less without layer 2 v than without layer 2 gate (main)
  16  MIN_DOWN_CHANGE = 0.025         # downstream is judged only if FULL flattens layers 5 to 51 by at least 2.5 percent
  17  MAX_RETAIN5_NOV2 = 0.70         # downstream: without layer 2 v the dial keeps at most 70 percent
  18  MIN_RETAIN5_NOV4 = 0.80         # downstream: without layer 4 v (same type, control) it keeps at least 80 percent
  19  
  20  
  21  def retained(tilts: dict) -> dict:
  22      """Each non-BASE, non-FULL condition's tilt change from BASE as a fraction of FULL's change. None if undefined."""
  23      if any(tilts.get(c) is None for c in CONDITIONS) or tilts["FULL"] == tilts["BASE"]:
  24          return {c: None for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}
  25      full = tilts["FULL"] - tilts["BASE"]
  26      return {c: (tilts[c] - tilts["BASE"]) / full for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}
  27  
  28  
  29  def book_orders(t: dict) -> bool:
  30      """A book counts if FULL flattens it and it keeps less of the change without layer 2 v than without layer 2's gate."""
  31      if any(t.get(c) is None for c in ("BASE", "FULL", "NOV2", "NOG2")):
  32          return False
  33      df = t["FULL"] - t["BASE"]
  34      if not df < 0:
  35          return False
  36      return bool((t["NOV2"] - t["BASE"]) / df < (t["NOG2"] - t["BASE"]) / df)

  39  def downstream_part(down: dict) -> dict:
  40      """Judged only if every downstream tilt is defined, tilt(BASE) is positive, FULL flattens layers 5 to 51 by at
  41      least MIN_DOWN_CHANGE, and V2 alone passes its downstream replication gate."""
  42      if down is None or any(down.get(c) is None for c in CONDITIONS) or down["BASE"] <= 0:
  43          return {"judged": False, "passes": False, "why": "a downstream tilt is undefined or tilt(BASE) is not positive"}
  44      change = (down["FULL"] - down["BASE"]) / down["BASE"]
  45      r = retained(down)
  46      out = {"full_change": change, **{f"retained_{c}": r[c] for c in CONDITIONS[2:]}}
  47      if change > -MIN_DOWN_CHANGE:
  48          return {**out, "judged": False, "passes": False,
  49                  "why": f"FULL flattens layers 5 to 51 by {-change:.3f}, less than {MIN_DOWN_CHANGE}"}
  50      lo, hi = V2_GATE_DOWN
  51      if not lo <= r["V2"] <= hi:
  52          return {**out, "judged": False, "passes": False,
  53                  "why": f"V2 alone keeps {r['V2']:.3f} downstream, outside {lo} to {hi}"}
  54      fails = [w for w, bad in (
  55          (f"without layer 2 v it keeps {r['NOV2']:.3f}, above {MAX_RETAIN5_NOV2}", r["NOV2"] > MAX_RETAIN5_NOV2),
  56          (f"without layer 4 v it keeps {r['NOV4']:.3f}, below {MIN_RETAIN5_NOV4}", r["NOV4"] < MIN_RETAIN5_NOV4)) if bad]
  57      return {**out, "judged": True, "passes": not fails, "why": "; ".join(fails) or None}
  58

  60  def necessity_outcome(main: dict, down: dict, book_main: list) -> dict:
  61      """main, down: set-level tilts per condition over layers 2 to 51 and 5 to 51; book_main: per book, its main tilts.
  62  
  63      U: a main tilt undefined, tilt(BASE) not positive, or FULL flattens the main tilt by less than 15 percent.
  64      R0: V2 alone keeps a main share outside 0.40 to 1.40 (C8 does not replicate here); necessity is not judged.
  65      Main window passes: retained(NOV2) <= 0.60, retained(NOG2) >= 0.80, and at least 4 of 5 books order NOV2 below NOG2.
  66      Downstream passes (when judged, see downstream_part): retained5(NOV2) <= 0.70 and retained5(NOV4) >= 0.80.
  67      N1: both pass. N1L: the main window passes and the downstream does not (or is not judged). N0: the main window fails.
  68      """
  69      if any(main.get(c) is None for c in CONDITIONS):
  70          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "a main tilt is undefined", "tilts": dict(main)}
  71      if main["BASE"] <= 0:
  72          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "tilt(BASE) is not positive", "tilts": dict(main)}
  73      full_change = (main["FULL"] - main["BASE"]) / main["BASE"]
  74      if full_change > -MIN_FULL_CHANGE:
  75          return {"outcome": "U", "reason": "FULL does not flatten the main tilt by at least 15 percent",
  76                  "full_change": full_change, "tilts": dict(main)}
  77      r = retained(main)
  78      books = sum(1 for t in book_main if book_orders(t))
  79      ds = downstream_part(down)
  80      common = {"full_change": full_change, **{f"retained_{c}": r[c] for c in CONDITIONS[2:]},
  81                "books_ordered": books, "downstream": ds,
  82                "gap_sufficiency_minus_necessity": r["V2"] - (1 - r["NOV2"]),   # V2 alone minus what removing it loses
  83                "tilts": dict(main), "tilts_downstream": dict(down) if down else None}
  84      lo, hi = V2_GATE_MAIN
  85      if not lo <= r["V2"] <= hi:
  86          return {"outcome": "R0", "reason": f"V2 alone keeps {r['V2']:.3f} of the main change, outside {lo} to {hi}: "
  87                                            f"C8 does not replicate here, so necessity is not judged",
  88                  "main_passes": False, **common}
  89      fails = [w for w, bad in (
  90          (f"without layer 2 v the dial keeps {r['NOV2']:.3f}, above {MAX_RETAIN_NOV2}", r["NOV2"] > MAX_RETAIN_NOV2),
  91          (f"without layer 2 gate it keeps {r['NOG2']:.3f}, below {MIN_RETAIN_NOG2}", r["NOG2"] < MIN_RETAIN_NOG2),
  92          (f"{books} of 5 books order NOV2 below NOG2, fewer than {MIN_BOOKS}", books < MIN_BOOKS)) if bad]
  93      main_passes = not fails
  94      if not main_passes:
  95          outcome, reason = "N0", "; ".join(fails)
  96      elif ds["passes"]:
  97          outcome, reason = "N1", None
  98      else:
  99          outcome, reason = "N1L", f"downstream: {ds['why']}"
 100      return {"outcome": outcome, "reason": reason, "main_passes": main_passes, **common}

  85  def curve(book, grid, cond, keep_layer=None):
  86      """Mean gain per N over every measured head (or over the heads of layers keep_layer accepts), and the
  87      whole-model SNR per N."""
  88      layer_ids = book["record"]["layers_measured"]
  89      keep = None if keep_layer is None else np.array([keep_layer(l) for l in layer_ids])
  90      out, snr = np.empty(len(grid)), np.empty(len(grid))
  91      for j, N in enumerate(grid):
  92          gain, _, snr[j] = cell_quantities(book["per_condition"][cond][str(N)])
  93          out[j] = (metrics.group_means(gain, layer_ids, book["global_layers"])["whole"] if keep is None
  94                    else float(gain[keep].mean()))
  95      return out, snr

  98  def set_tilts(curves: dict, grid) -> tuple:
  99      """Set-level tilt per condition, each fit over the periods valid (median SNR >= 3 over books) under every
 100      condition."""
 101      valid = {c: np.median(np.stack([x[1] for x in curves[c]]), axis=0) >= VALID_SNR for c in CONDITIONS}
 102      common = np.logical_and.reduce([valid[c] for c in CONDITIONS])
 103      tilts = {c: metrics_c2.tilt(grid, np.mean(np.stack([x[0] for x in curves[c]]), axis=0), common)
 104               for c in CONDITIONS}
 105      return tilts, common, valid

 110      return {c: metrics_c2.tilt(grid, curves[c][i][0], common) for c in CONDITIONS}

 113  def group_diagnostic(books, grid, common) -> dict:
 114      """Reported, never gated (pre-registered): set-level tilts per condition and shares over (a) layer 2's heads,
 115      (b) layers 3 to 51, (c) layers 5 to 51 (downstream of layer 2's and layer 4's modules), (d) layers 6 to 51 (no adapter), fit over
 116      the main periods. A group with no measured layer is None."""
 117      groups = {"layer2": lambda l: l == 2, "layers3_51": lambda l: l >= 3, "layers5_51": lambda l: l >= 5,
 118                "layers6_51": lambda l: l >= 6}
 119      out = {}
 120      measured = books[0]["record"]["layers_measured"]
 121      for name, fn in groups.items():
 122          if not any(fn(l) for l in measured):
 123              out[name] = None
 124              continue
 125          t = {c: metrics_c2.tilt(grid, np.mean(np.stack([curve(b, grid, c, fn)[0] for b in books]), axis=0), common)
 126               for c in CONDITIONS}
 127          rel = {c: ((t[c] - t["BASE"]) / t["BASE"] if None not in (t[c], t["BASE"]) and t["BASE"] else None)
 128                 for c in CONDITIONS if c != "BASE"}
 129          out[name] = {"tilts": t, "relative_change": rel, "retained": metrics_c9.retained(t)}
 130      return out

 140  def analyze(run_dir: str, spec: dict, seal_hash: str = None, code: dict = None, partial: bool = False) -> dict:
 141      grid = spec["drive"]["periods_N"]
 142      books, pa = load_books(run_dir, spec, seal_hash, code)
 143      expected = sorted(int(g) for v in spec["inputs"]["prompt_sets"].values() for g in v)
 144      found = sorted(b["gutenberg_id"] for b in books)
 145      complete = found == expected
 146      if not complete and not partial:
 147          raise SystemExit(f"Incomplete run: no outcome. Found {found}, expected {expected}.")
 148      if complete and partial:
 149          raise SystemExit("The run is complete; analyze it without --partial.")
 150      curves = {c: [curve(b, grid, c) for b in books] for c in CONDITIONS}
 151      curves5 = {c: [curve(b, grid, c, DOWN) for b in books] for c in CONDITIONS}
 152      tilts, common, valid = set_tilts(curves, grid)
 153      down = window_tilts(curves5, grid, common) if common.sum() else {c: None for c in CONDITIONS}
 154      per_book = []
 155      for i, b in enumerate(books):
 156          t = book_tilts(curves, grid, i)
 157          ok = np.logical_and.reduce([curves[c][i][1] >= VALID_SNR for c in CONDITIONS])
 158          t5 = {c: metrics_c2.tilt(grid, curves5[c][i][0], ok) for c in CONDITIONS}
 159          per_book.append({"gutenberg_id": b["gutenberg_id"], "tilts": t, "retained": metrics_c9.retained(t),
 160                           "ordered": metrics_c9.book_orders(t), "tilts_downstream": t5,
 161                           "retained_downstream": metrics_c9.retained(t5)})
 162      c9 = metrics_c9.necessity_outcome(tilts, down, [x["tilts"] for x in per_book])
 163      if not complete:                       # a partial look has no outcome; its numbers are kept apart
 164          c9 = {"outcome": None, "partial_diagnostic": c9}
 165      ppl = {c: float(np.median([b["perplexity"][c] / b["perplexity"]["BASE"] for b in books])) for c in CONDITIONS}
 166      result = {"run_dir": run_dir, "complete": complete, "grid": grid, "books": len(books),
 167                "failure_records": sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(run_dir, "*.FAILED.*.json"))),
 168                "C9": c9, "tilts": tilts, "tilts_downstream": down, "periods_used": [g for g, v in zip(grid, common) if v],
 169                "valid": {c: v.tolist() for c, v in valid.items()},
 170                "curves": {c: np.mean(np.stack([x[0] for x in curves[c]]), axis=0).tolist() for c in CONDITIONS},
 171                "book_tilts": per_book, "perplexity_ratio_median": ppl,
 172                "modules_on": {c: len(v["modules_on"]) for c, v in pa["record"]["conditions"].items()},
 173                "diagnostic_groups": group_diagnostic(books, grid, common),
 174                "reproduction": "not applicable: no earlier run measured set A at tokens 32,768 to 65,535"}
 175      mean_book = {}
 176      for key in ("retained", "retained_downstream"):
 177          for c in ("NOV2", "NOV4", "NOG2"):
 178              v = [x[key][c] for x in per_book if x[key][c] is not None]
 179              mean_book[f"{key}_{c}"] = float(np.mean(v)) if v else None
 180      result["secondary_mean_of_book_shares"] = dict(mean_book, books=len(per_book),
 181                                                     note="Muse Wonder's proposed per-book mean; reported, not gated")
 182      if not complete:
 183          result["warning"] = "PARTIAL: diagnostic look only. An incomplete run has no C9 outcome."
 184      rng = np.random.default_rng([0, 0])
 185      n = len(books)
 186      boot = {"retained_V2": [], "retained_NOV2": [], "retained_NOV4": [], "retained_NOG2": [], "full_change": [],
 187              "retained5_V2": [], "retained5_NOV2": [], "retained5_NOV4": [], "full_change5": []}
 188      for _ in range(BOOT):

 190          t2, common2, _ = set_tilts({c: [curves[c][i] for i in pick] for c in CONDITIONS}, grid)
 191          if None not in t2.values() and t2["BASE"] > 0:      # each window is resampled and judged on its own
 192              fc = (t2["FULL"] - t2["BASE"]) / t2["BASE"]

  35  def c9_spec(path, sha, c5spec, start=START):
  36      tr = c5spec["training"]
  37      return {"inputs": {"prompt_sets": {"A": {7: "y"}}, "text_sha256": c5spec["inputs"]["text_sha256"],
  38                         "length_tokens": c5spec["inputs"]["length_tokens"], "segment_start_token": start},
  39              "drive": {"periods_N": GRID},
  40              "adapter": {"file": path, "sha256": sha, "family": tr["family"], "layers": tr["layers"],
  41                          "rank": tr["rank"], "alpha": tr["alpha"]},
  42              "conditions": {"BASE": {"scale": 0.0, "modules": "all"}, "FULL": {"scale": 2.0, "modules": "all"},
  43                             **{c: {"scale": 2.0, "modules": copy.deepcopy(m)} for c, m in MODS.items()}},
  44              "budget": {"max_gpu_hours": 1, "seconds_per_pass_estimate": 0.01}}

  47  def session(tmp_path, monkeypatch, spec=None, sha=None, allow_unfilled=False, start=START):
  48      monkeypatch.setattr(run_c9, "CHECK_LAYER", 5)          # after every adapted toy layer, as layer 10 is on Glimmer
  49      monkeypatch.setattr(run_c9, "PHASE_A_BOOK", 7)
  50      path, real_sha, c5spec = make_adapter(tmp_path)
  51      P.configure(8192)
  52      spec = spec or c9_spec(path, sha or real_sha, c5spec, start)
  53      lm, full, texts, tok = toy_world(tmp_path)
  54      s = object.__new__(run_c9.Session)
  55      s.repo, s.spec, s.seal_hash, s.code = "", spec, "testseal", {"f": "h"}
  56      s.ledger = run_c9.Ledger(str(tmp_path / "ledger9"), "testseal0000", 3600)
  57      s.texts, s.tok, s.model, s.decoder, s.layers, s.platform = texts, tok, full, lm, lm.layers, {"global_layers": [3]}
  58      run_c9.Session._setup(s, allow_unfilled)
  59      for hd in s.probe.handles:
  60          hd.remove()
  61      s.probe = HeadProbe(lm.layers, s.layer_ids, 4, s.t1)
  62      d = torch.zeros(D); d[0] = 1.0
  63      s.injector.remove(); s.direction = d
  64      s.injector = WaveInjector(lm.layers[1], d)
  65      return s, spec
